machine_package.analysis: Shadow-only weekly calibration: completed week 44 realized a net decline in BTC and ETH after an early advance, a sharp midweek selloff, and partial late repair. The dominant calibration issue is path interpretation: neither early stabilization nor late rebound was sufficient evidence of durable continuation. Relative and breadth evidence remained weak, but did not justify treating every short-horizon weakness signal as a reliable downside continuation. Existing Official/Shadow comparisons and experimental outcomes do not authorize a winner, threshold change, model promotion, or operational action.
